subject: general
question: By which amendment in the Constitution of India was declared that the Union Territory of Delhi would be called the National Capital Territory of Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Constitution (Sixty-ninth Amendment) Act, 1991**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

69th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1991:

 
• 69 Amendment Constitutional Amendment Act of 1991 designated the Union Territory of Delhi as the National Capital Territory of Delhi.
 
• The 69th Amendment act of the Indian Constitution granted special status to Delhi in 1991. it was declared the National Capital Territory.
 
• It created a state assembly and council of ministers for the state.
 
• Aditya Nath Jha became the first Lieutenant Governor of Delhi under the act.
 
• Article 239AA of the Constitution gave the status of Union Territory to Delhi.
